title: Enthusiastic Consent
summary: Enthusiastic consent means looking for a clear, willing 'yes' — in words or obvious eagerness — rather than just the absence of a 'no'.
key_points: Checking in ('Is this okay?', 'Want to keep going?') is normal and can be caring and sexy.
Hesitation, freezing or pulling away means pause and check.
answer_guidance: Explain factually and non-graphically in the user's language (English, Banglish or Bengali). Start with a simple definition and add detail only if asked. Be non-judgemental; mention consent, safety or seeing a doctor only where genuinely relevant.
